tasks: Disease-specific chemical retrieval with pairs of sources versus all integrated sources
studies.results: Disease-chemical query gives 77 compounds using OMIM+DrugBank and 45,606 with all included datasets; counts demonstrate source coverage, not precision/recall or clinical value. PPI union contains 67,769 unique protein pairs.
limitations: All-source condition has greater information coverage; no semantic correctness ground truth or equivalent content comparison.

Analytical graph mining, predictive associations, richer provenance and CRF term extraction are future work.
